body.statement: Let \(S=(S_c)_{c=1}^C\) have \(|S_c|\geq 3\), and expand every support \(S_c\) into the anchor triples of \(H_3\).  For almost every two-dimensional subspace of \(\mathbb R^T\), its coordinate projections on the supports \(S_c\) determine it uniquely if and only if the expanded triple multiset contains \(T-2\) triples such that every subcollection of \(k\) triples is supported on at least \(k+2\) coordinates.

source.locator: Appendix, Theorem 3, together with equation (1) in Theorem 1
